sources.title: WWPA: Frequently Asked Questions for Employees
sources.publisher: New York State Department of Labor
sources.scope: Employee consultation during injury-reduction program design and worksite evaluation.
limits: Consultation duties do not establish a general veto over all monitoring systems.

sources.title: Workplace Safety Committee
sources.publisher: New York State Department of Labor
sources.scope: Joint labor-management safety committee formation, composition and worker selection safeguards.
limits: Applies within the statute and implementing rules.

sources.title: FAQs for Warehouse Workers (Minn. Stat. 182.6526)
sources.publisher: Minnesota Department of Labor and Industry
sources.scope: Quota description, measurement, adverse consequences, work-speed access and warehouse scope.

sources.title: Visual Disabilities in the Workplace and the ADA
sources.scope: Algorithmic productivity example involving keystroke counts and voice-recognition use, plus accommodation guidance.
limits: Technical assistance is not a case judgment.

sources.title: EEOC and DOJ Warn Against Disability Discrimination in AI Employment Tools
sources.scope: Use of software and AI in selection, monitoring, pay and promotion, and ADA screen-out risk.
limits: Does not establish misuse in any named deployment.

sources.title: Data protection and monitoring workers
sources.scope: DPIAs, worker consultation, accuracy, transparency, purpose limitation and challenge rights in monitoring.
limits: Guidance is under review following statutory changes and is not a case ruling.

sources.title: Monitoring tools that use solely automated processes
sources.scope: Significant worker decisions, explanation, challenge and meaningful human oversight requirements.

sources.title: Biometric data for time, access control and monitoring
sources.scope: Manual review and rapid access restoration where automated biometric control fails.
limits: Biometric-access context; not every algorithmic discipline system.
